cards.title: Pick a style
cards.text: The same moment drawn four ways. Tick the ones you like.
cards.why: This sets every picture in the game. They differ in how shapes and walls are drawn, not in colours. Colours are the next card.

items.label: A: thin line
items.text: Outlines only, strong glow, no floor grid. Most 'vector'.

items.label: B: solid
items.text: Filled glowing shapes, bright solid walls.

items.label: C: line + soft fill
items.text: Outline plus a faint fill, double-line walls, faint grid. My pick: reads fast, glow stays cheap.

items.label: D: flat
items.text: No glow at all, thick lines, flat fills. Cheapest to run on the phone.

cards.title: One job per colour
cards.text: Each colour means one thing, so a glance tells you what's dangerous.
cards.why: From your maze doc: each visual channel gets one job. Mark anything that clashes.

parts.title: You: cyan and white
parts.text: The player, your shots, your summon. Enemy shots are never cyan.

parts.title: Enemies: red and magenta
parts.text: Enemy bodies are red or magenta. Enemy shots are red and always drawn on top of yours.

parts.title: Green and gold
parts.text: XP gems are mint green. Chests and gold are amber, and glow through the dark.

parts.title: Statuses in their colours
parts.text: Burn orange, Chill pale ice, Shock yellow, Poison lime, Mark pink.

parts.title: Size = health
parts.text: A bigger enemy has more HP. Rings and particles show modules.

parts.title: Rarity
parts.text: Common white, Rare blue, Epic purple, Legendary gold.

cards.title: Working title
cards.why: Only so files and the Riffle pack have a name. Plain, says what it's about, no neon in it.
cards.pick: Spellmaze until you think of better.
